PageSpeed web RPC fixtures captured on 2026-10-29 from the public example.com
analysis `bidxril0yk` at pagespeed.web.dev.

`analysis-pending.json` is the analysis returned by `nqfuif` (CreateAnalysis),
with all six result placeholders and the original protocol timestamp.

`analysis-complete.json` is the completed `CBayme` (GetAnalysis) response. All
six result records and every CrUX metric are retained. Each Lighthouse JSON
report was reduced to its identity, environment, configuration, warnings, all
categories, full page screenshot, and four representative audits. Screenshot
bytes, metric details, unknown category data, and every retained value are
unchanged. The separately captured `LsX2he` response confirmed the same result
schema for polling individual result IDs.

Synthetic mutations in the parser tests cover future enum/metric variants,
malformed data, protocol errors, and Web Vitals boundary conditions. The
boundary values and optional-INP assessment follow the captured web client's
MTppr metric configuration and Aua eligibility/assessment implementation.
